calls.statement:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.channel_code, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.etl_loaded_at, cp.subcategory AS cur_sub, p.subcategory AS was_sub, p.category AS was_cat, cp.category AS cur_cat
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE st.store_id = 107 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
)
SELECT cur_cat, cur_sub, was_sub, count(*) lines, count(distinct sales_line_id) dl, sum(quantity) units, sum(net_amount) net, min(sale_date), max(sale_date), sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) staff_units, min(quantity), max(quantity)
FROM s WHERE cur_sub = 'Cleaning Products' OR was_sub = 'Cleaning Products'
GROUP BY ALL

calls.statement:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE st.store_id=107 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
)
SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM f GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_receipt_lines,
 (SELECT sum(quantity) FROM f) AS fact_units,
 (SELECT sum(units_sold) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=107 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS rpt_units,
 (SELECT count(distinct business_date) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=107 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS rpt_days,
 (SELECT count(distinct sale_date) FROM f) AS fact_days,
 (SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM f) AS fact_net,
 (SELECT sum(net_sales_before_returns) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=107 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS rpt_net,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM f WHERE channel_code <> 'ST' OR channel_code IS NULL) AS nonST
